description: Lists things to do near one Booking Bench site, alphabetically. Each activity has id, name, category, location, website, admission and contactInfo, plus source (who supplied it; property_manager means the site's own manager) and commercial (whether it is a paid placement). The answer gives total, per-category counts and nextCursor.

category.description: An activity category name from the categories in an earlier answer.

cursor.description: The nextCursor from an earlier answer to the same search, unchanged.

limit.description: How many activities to return, up to 100.

query.description: Words to find in the name, location or category.

siteSlug.description: The siteSlug of a Booking Bench site, as returned by list_sites.

name: list_activities
title: List local activities
